answer.rationale: At 94% committed volume with no buffer and only 14 days remaining, a full primary-vendor switch could increase delivery risk. Verify the incumbent’s continuity record and the low-cost vendor’s onboarding history—especially whether the latter establishes production-scale delivery reliability, not merely quick onboarding and accurate invoicing. Current intent is to preserve supply through renewal, despite the unresolved 18% savings mandate, unless verification shows the switch can occur without added delivery risk.
